hints.title: String Prototype Replication
hints.text: Extend the primitive prototype to produce a repeated concatenation of the instance character sequence.

hints.title: Array Fill Concatenation
hints.text: Construct an array sized to the requested repetitions, populate every index with the current string instance, and join without delimiters.

hints.title: Replicate Prototype Blueprint
hints.text: Define String.prototype.replicate = function(times) and return new Array(times).fill(this).join("").

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Constructs the resulting repeated string in linear time relative to output length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Modifying String.prototype improperly or using recursive string concatenation causes excessive intermediate allocations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates array of references before single join concatenation pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean prototype method attachment and proper reference binding to this.

solutions.approach: Array Fill and Join Prototype Polyfill
